nelsonBakerPrimary.use: theory lineage; the executable comparator below follows the equations and constants printed and released with Lamb et al.

positiveEvidence: The acquired IceNODE Data/preprocess.py constructs LevDataUncertainty_noHarrison.pth.
The same preprocessing file labels the combined arrays as no Harrison.
whyNotDefinitive: The public snapshot omits the data bodies, serialized loader, training checkpoint, and experiment-ID bundle.
The paper cites Harrison 2016 as an apparatus/data source, so citation alone cannot establish row overlap or absence.
No published identifier join maps the 290 training histories to the 16 Phase 8 archive members.

conditionMapping.temperature: Use corrected Pokrifka 2020 central tempC plus 273.15 K; retain its marginal range but do not combine it with other ranges in this protocol.
conditionMapping.pressure: Use each registered measured pressurePa. The released IceNODE fixed 97190 Pa convention is a diagnostic only.
conditionMapping.supersaturation: Convert corrected ambient chamber sigmaIcePercent to excessIceSupersaturationFraction by division by 100. It is an ambient drive for this reduced comparator, not measured surface supersaturation.
conditionMapping.initialMass: Use a sphere of rhoIce=910 kg m^-3 at corrected initialRadiusUm. This is the Lamb/released-code mass convention and an analysis assumption because initial products may be polycrystalline.
conditionMapping.forcing: Treat each registered temperature, pressure, and ambient drive as constant during its history.
conditionMapping.observable: Direct positive mass ratio m/m0 only; never use the archive's undocumented sixth column.

observationOperator.rawRows: Read all three-column NAS TSV rows after hash and byte-length verification; preserve observed decreases.
observationOperator.duplicates: Group exact-equal source times, sort that group's mass-ratio values ascending, and use the ordinary median; do not smooth or force monotonicity.
observationOperator.timeZero: If the first source time is positive and its mass ratio is exactly one, prepend the definitional project anchor (0 s, 1). Refuse a later-starting history whose first ratio is not one.
observationOperator.interpolation: Linear interpolation between adjacent coalesced source times at integer seconds.
observationOperator.grid: Use 0 through min(499, floor(last source time in seconds)), inclusive. The earlier phrase 0-500 s is shorthand for the paper's strict t < 500 s domain; no t=500 point is scored.
observationOperator.shortHistories: Do not pad. Histories ending before 500 s stop at floor(last source time).
observationOperator.rights: Normalized row bodies remain NAS-local; published evidence contains only derived scores, diagnostics, identities, and hashes permitted by the governing rights boundary.

modelOperator.state: One positive mass in kg with spherical radius r=(3m/(4*pi*rhoIce))^(1/3).
modelOperator.integration: Fixed-step classical RK4 with exactly one-second steps and output at every registered grid second; reject a nonconsecutive, shifted, negative, or post-499 grid.

comparators.definition: Gc is the reciprocal sum of the printed vapor and thermal resistances, with Murphy-Koop ice vapor pressure, Dv=2.11e-5*(T/273.15)^1.94*(101325/P), and the released air-conductivity relation.
comparators.control: Positive finite Gc and analytic spherical constant-G solution must agree with RK4 within the test-pinned numerical tolerance.

comparators.definition: Project hybrid using the source-lineage critical-drive expression attachmentCoefficientNB=(s/scrit)*tanh(scrit/s), with scrit=9.6066e-5*abs(tempC)^1.9171, plus the released transitional vapor and heat corrections before the same resistance sum.
projectDeviations: It supplies corrected ambient chamber excess S_i-1 where the Nelson-Baker theory requires local surface excess; no local-surface closure is implemented.
It retains the released thermal-jump correction even though the Nelson-Baker paper says to ignore the thermal jump in this treatment.
It uses each history's measured pressure rather than the released snapshot's fixed 97190 Pa.
comparators.releasedCodeDiscrepancy: The released models.py supplies saturation ratio S_i rather than excess S_i-1 to this expression. Preserve that behavior only as a separately named discrepancy diagnostic; it is not this project hybrid.
comparators.claimLimit: The three project deviations, missing released data/loader/checkpoint, and documented input seam forbid calling this a Nelson-Baker reproduction or an exact reproduction of Lamb Table 1.

comparators.definition: G=1e-9*[((1e9*Gc)^1.3153063)/(1/1.1682062+2.6606467/(1e12*m))+0.1123054], using each registered measured pressure in Gc.
seams: G tends to 1.123054e-10 kg m^-1 s^-1 rather than zero as mass tends to zero.
The large-mass expression does not tend to Gc.
It is a bulk surrogate with no facet, habit, support, ventilation, or initiation state.

comparators.definition: For each held-out primary history, fit one multiplier q in q*Gc against the other five histories only, then evaluate that frozen q on the held-out history.
comparators.trainingLoss: Arithmetic mean of the five per-history MSE values; never pool time points.

search.basis: same 0 <= G/Gc <= 2 range used by the weak IceNODE model
search.refinement: 80 fixed golden-section iterations over the two coarse intervals neighboring the best coarse node
search.boundaryHandling: report a minimum or maximum boundary solution by name; do not silently widen after seeing it

perHistory: MSE over that history's registered integer-second grid
mean signed predicted-minus-observed residual and its sign
endpoint predicted-minus-observed residual and its sign
negative, exact-zero, and positive residual counts
score.family: Arithmetic mean of the six per-history MSE values. A longer history receives no greater family weight.

primaryDecision.expectedEffect: On central inputs only, the Lamb comparator has strictly lower equal-history MSE than the leave-one-history-out rescale and strictly lower per-history MSE in at least four of six held-out histories.
primaryDecision.operator: Compute both arithmetic means over the exact six per-history MSE values. Family equality is failure. For each history, Lamb equality with the rescale is not a win. Survives only when Lamb family MSE is strictly lower and the strict Lamb win count is at least four; every other outcome is no-effect-or-failure.
primaryDecision.survives: Both strict parts of the expected effect occur on central inputs.
primaryDecision.noEffectOrFailure: Either strict part does not occur, including any relevant tie; publish the disagreement without changing the rule.
primaryDecision.promotionLimit: A surviving result promotes only a bounded bulk comparator. It does not identify a physical surface mechanism or validate a crystal model.

score.otherComparisons: Report continuum and the project ambient-excess hybrid beside both rivals without using them to weaken the precommitted Lamb-versus-rescale decision.

sensitivity.centralPrimary: The primary decision is computed once from the six central condition/radius/observation cases. Sensitivities never replace or refit that primary result.

initialRadius.cases: For each history separately, vary only that held-out history to corrected central radius minus or plus its source-stated marginal range.
initialRadius.leaveOneHistoryOut: Fit each fold multiplier once on the five central-radius, central-observation training histories. Never refit on a sensitivity. Evaluate that fixed multiplier only on its held-out history's lower or upper radius.
initialRadius.combinationRule: Compare the strict Lamb-versus-rescale win for that one history with its central win. Do not compute a sensitivity family score, all-low/all-high envelope, Cartesian corner set, or probabilistic interval.

massRatioMaximumError.sourceStatement: maximum relative error 5 percent; not a confidence interval, standard deviation, or probability distribution
massRatioMaximumError.heldoutOnly: For each fold separately, leave its central five-history training fit unchanged and vary only the held-out observations by minus or plus five percent.
reports: MSE against the coherent diagnostic y*0.95 series
MSE against the coherent diagnostic y*1.05 series
mean squared distance outside that band
massRatioMaximumError.limit: Each shift applies only to one held-out history at a time. It is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a joint temporal or six-history uncertainty envelope. Do not combine it with radius cases.

sensitivity.decisionLabel: If any held-out history's strict Lamb-versus-rescale win flips under a named radius or mass-ratio case, label the result sensitivity-dependent. Temperature and supersaturation one-factor cases are not implemented, so promotion is unavailable even when the central result survives and no named win flips.
